name: Comic City (Fukuoka)
blurb: Kyushu edition of the Comic City doujinshi (fan comic) market network, held roughly twice a year at Marine Messe Fukuoka.

editions.evidence: Akaboo (organizer) homepage schedule list: '02月28日（福岡）COMIC CITY 福岡 65' (Feb 28, 2027). Venue confirmed for the immediately preceding edition by i-fukuoka.jp: 'COMIC CITY 福岡63｜2026年2月23日開催・マリンメッセ福岡で同人誌即売会', and by the organizer's own X/Twitter venue-guide posts naming Marine Messe Fukuoka for recent editions.
Akaboo (organizer) homepage schedule list: '06月20日（福岡）COMIC CITY 福岡 66' (Jun 20, 2027), same numbered series and venue pattern as edition 65 above.

notes: This is the plain numbered 'COMIC CITY 福岡' series (63, 64, 65, 66…), Akaboo's regular Kyushu doujinshi market; the Jun 2026 instalment (COMIC CITY 福岡 64) already fell before the 2026-10-05 research window and is left out. A doujin-circle table-sales market, not a guest-driven convention — no celebrity guest program, so guests is 'none'. Cover reuses the shared akaboo.jp homepage extract saved under comic-city-tokyo (same organizer portal, same dynamically-themed 'COMIC CITY' wordmark logo at logo:0); no Fukuoka-specific key art was found.
